lines.text: Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees shut the kingdom of heaven in men's faces and make converts twice as much sons of hell.
Jesus says anyone who swears by the silver of the temple is bound by his oath, though the temple is greater.
Jesus says they pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin but disregard justice, mercy, and faithfulness.
Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees are like whitewashed tombs, which on the inside are full of grain and oil.
Jesus says He longed to gather Jerusalem's children as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but they were unwilling.
